row.evidence: Bitwarden's business pricing page lists "Automate provisioning with SCIM" on the Teams plan ($4 per user/month billed annually), and its SCIM docs say "Teams and Enterprise organizations can use SCIM."
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM, Directory Connector, event logs and the Public API are on Teams ($4/u/mo annual) and Enterprise ($6/u/mo annual); SAML/OIDC SSO and JIT are Enterprise only, and SSO is not required for SCIM. A free 2-person organization exists without these tools. Deactivation in the IdP revokes the member (no seat used); Okta deletes also only revoke. Entra and OneLogin use generic/non-gallery SCIM apps; Okta (OIN app) and JumpCloud (catalogue app) have Bitwarden apps; Google Workspace syncs only via Bitwarden's Directory Connector. The org Public API (OAuth2 client credentials) can create, update, revoke, restore and remove members, manage groups and read events.

scim.notes: sso_required=false inferred: SCIM is on Teams, where Login with SSO is not available. The SCIM URL is shown per organization in Admin Console > Settings > SCIM provisioning; no URL pattern is published.

auth.token_source: Admin Console > Settings > SCIM provisioning (SCIM URL and SCIM API key)

operations.notes: Status changes sync (Entra sends active via the IsSoftDeleted mapping). Display name, external ID and email changes do not sync. Okta 'Delete user' only revokes; SCIM event logs mention 'removing users', so whether a SCIM DELETE removes the member is unclear.

deprovision.data_retained: Revoked members stay listed under the Revoked tab, lose access to organization vault items and collections, cannot use SSO, and can be restored.

limitations.text: Display name and external ID changes in the IdP are not synced; email address changes are not supported once provisioned.
The SCIM API cannot be used to query group membership; use the Public API.
Okta 'suspended' status does not revoke the member; Okta deletes only revoke.
Directory Connector must be turned off before enabling SCIM.
Provisioned users default to Staged status (no invite, no seat) until invited, unless automatic invitations are on.

endpoints.purpose: Revoke a member's access to the organization

okta.notes: OIN app (last updated Jul 2026): SAML, OIDC, SCIM, Create, Deactivate, Group Push checked in page markup.

entra.notes: Bitwarden's SCIM guide uses a Non-gallery enterprise application; Microsoft's Bitwarden Learn tutorial URLs return 404.

google.notes: Google Workspace is not in Bitwarden's SCIM IdP list; provisioning via Bitwarden Directory Connector.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Enterprise)' app.

jumpcloud.notes: Bitwarden's JumpCloud guide selects a 'Bitwarden' app from JumpCloud's application catalogue; JumpCloud's own page not loaded.
